_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in. config.json is gitignored: it holds a Proxmox API token and the Windows account password in clear text. chmod 600 it.
_comment_template: VMID of the sysprepped Windows 11 template built by windows11/make-template.sh.
_comment_pool: Every sandbox is created into this pool, and the app refuses to touch any VM that is not in it AND inside id_range. Both checks must pass.
_comment_bridge: SDN vnet the sandboxes attach to. Isolated from the LAN, NATs outbound.
_comment_listen: Control API + web UI. Sandboxes must NOT be able to reach this port.
_comment_payload: Deskhand builds are served on their own port, and that is the only port the sandbox firewall rule allows through. A compromised sandbox can fetch a zip and nothing else.
_comment_windows: Local account created in each sandbox. The password is used for auto-logon and lands in the guest registry in clear text, which is why this belongs only on disposable VMs.
_comment_agents: Optional. Seeds an AI agent installed INSIDE a sandbox (see the Agents button / install_agents tool). The keys are written to the sandbox's environment and to Hermes's .env; every sandbox also gets its own Deskhand added as an MCP server automatically, so the agent can drive the desktop it runs on. Leave empty to install unconfigured.

agents._comment_endpoint: Default inference endpoint for agents installed in a sandbox. Any OpenAI-compatible server (llama.cpp, vLLM, Ollama, LM Studio). Overridable per install in the UI. Leave api_key empty if the server needs none. A LAN endpoint also needs a firewall exception -- see the README.
